summary: Nomura Holdings filed a Form 6-K reporting the finalization of treasury share dispositions as stock awards under multiple Restricted Stock Unit (RSU) plans. The company allotted 25,116 shares at ¥371/share (RSU No.14), 95,288 shares at ¥436/share (RSU No.20), and 746,120 shares at ¥577/share (RSU No.26) via contribution-in-kind of monetary compensation claims to directors, executive officers, and employees. This is an ordinary equity compensation matter rather than a special situation.
